with Si Kusum, Ps Mandir Marg.
Coram:

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.04.2023 CRL.M.A. 10529/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

This petition has been filed for seeking directions to the Ld. MM-02 (Mahila Court), Patiala House Courts, for compliance of order dated 31.01.2019, vide which the petitioners have been permanently exempted from appearance before the learned Court on account of their old age and suffering from ailments as well as the fact that they are residents of Uttarakhand.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioners adverted to the medical documents filed before this Court as well as the fact that the petitioners are now residing in District Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, and he has been moving an exemption application on every date before the Ld. MM.
3. Ld. ASC, however, contends that this is the practice in the Ld. Trial Court despite permanent exemption being granted.

3. In these facts and circumstances, it is directed that the Ld. M.M. in view of the order dated 31.01.2019 passed in the said proceedings, may not insist on appearance of the petitioners, who are represented through counsel, unless and until required for the purposes of identification and recording of their testimonies.
The petitioners may be allowed to present themselves through VC before the Ld. MM for the purpose of presence, unless otherwise required for any other reason.
4. No further directions are required.
The Writ Petition is disposed of with the above directions.
